title: encore doctor --json
description: The document `encore doctor --json` prints. Committed so a healthcheck or a monitoring script can be written against a shape that is held by a test (tests/test_doctor.py) rather than against whatever last week's build happened to emit. It carries no timestamp on purpose: the output must be byte-stable across runs on unchanged state, and a generated-at field would make every run differ.

schema.description: Identifies this document's shape. Bumped only on a breaking change to it.

exit_code.description: The process exit code: 0 every check passed, 1 at least one warning, 2 at least one failure. `skipped` contributes nothing, because a check that could not run is neither a pass nor a failure.

summary.description: How many checks landed in each status. The four keys are always present, including the ones that are zero.

checks.description: One object per check, in the order an operator should read them.

name.description: Stable identifier for the check. Scheduler checks are `scheduler:<job id>`; upstream probes, present only under --check-upstream, are `upstream:<name>`.

status.description: `skipped` means the check did not run and says why in `detail`. It is never a disguised pass.

detail.description: What was observed. Never contains a Plex token, an Apprise URL, the feed token, or an artist name; text taken from a stored exception is scrubbed of anything URL-shaped first.

next_step.description: What the operator should do about it. Null when, and only when, the status is `pass`.
